categories.name: theological
categories.summary: Mostly the relationship of Son and Father: dependence as mutual, authority without lesser being, and whether trusting an offered story brings more meaning than self-authoring. Careful movement from the eternal relations toward hypostasis.

categories.name: philosophical
categories.summary: Questions of what grounds a worldview: which materialist positions and what would count as grounding, how terms for the mind are distinguished, and a first reading of Nietzsche.

categories.name: political
categories.summary: Monarchy set against the nation-state, and a separate note on the rights of children.

categories.name: etymological
categories.summary: Attention to what words carry, such as thresholds and crossings and the exact senses of related terms. The origins of "modern" and "secular" are an open, unchecked question.

categories.name: psychological
categories.summary: Read through Peterson: a note on children and a lecture introducing Nietzsche.

categories.name: hemispherological
categories.summary: The Master and his Emissary as a frame, including cold, analytical handling of moral and spiritual matters as a left-hemisphere pattern.

categories.name: civilizationological
categories.summary: Hall's frame taken as reaching beyond any one paradigm, applied to monarchy versus the nation-state and to a wider conversation about where the West is.

categories.name: symbological
categories.summary: Thresholds and crossings as symbols, and the question of which symbols make monarchy richest.

categories.name: cognitive
categories.summary: Relevance realization as a starting point, how the pieces of cognition are distinguished, and its place in the wider conversation about the West.

categories.name: techne
categories.summary: Tools and systems as human coverings: what a tool is and whether it extends or replaces the maker's skill, and the household's own digital toolset (the apps and sites they build).

categoriesNote: Claude's reading of entries he has placed. Proposals are not included.
